independent_DATA_negative_M2_audit.scope: Cached Phase 4 DATA photon negative-invariant sign audit
independent_DATA_negative_M2_audit.method: Exact rational binary32 input; 100 decimal digits repeated at 75 digits
independent_DATA_negative_M2_audit.interpretation: Negativity is in the exact supplied binary32 tuples and remains invalid. The conservative half-ULP envelope alone does not prove an attainable correlated perturbation. Energy-only zero-crossing witnesses, when present, establish existence within an assumed rounding interval, not the actual physical, calibration or rounding origin. Inputs and invalid classifications are unchanged; origin UNKNOWN.
